project_type: Static bilingual (Marathi/English) HTML exam-paper website. Single-page master viewer with 10 exam papers (Std 1-10) as <article id='paper-std-N'> blocks, tab navigation, A4 print support.
language: HTML + inline CSS + a small vanilla JS showClass() tab switcher. No frameworks.
build_system: None. Pure static site. render.yaml publishes '.' as a Static Site on Render.
test_framework: None. Verification is structural: HTML well-formedness and internal mark consistency.
build_command: None (static). Validation: open index.html in a browser; run an HTML tag-balance sanity check.
test_command: None. Structural checks: verify each Std 5-10 paper's section marks sum to 20; Std 1-4 stay at 10; confirm balanced div/table/tr/td tags; confirm no correct answers are visually marked.
verification_instructions: 1) Std 1-4 remain the EXISTING visual/image papers at 10 marks each (current pattern, current images/*.jpg only). Do NOT restructure them to the pasted 20-mark text. Only add Marathi where any option/label/match cell is English-only. 2) Std 5-10 are REBUILT to exactly match the user-provided question spec (verbatim questions/options), fully bilingual (Marathi + English in BOTH questions and every option and every fill-in choice and both match columns). 3) Each Std 5-10 paper's sections must sum to exactly 20 (Std5/6/7/8: A6+B3+C3+D4+E4; Std9/10: A4+B3+C3+D4+E3+F3). 4) meta-chips 'एकूण गुण: २०', marks box '/ २०', and tab-subtext '(20 Marks)' stay correct. 5) Since the new Std 5-10 papers have NO OR/किंवा sections, remove the general-instructions bullet that references अंतर्गत पर्याय ('किंवा' / OR) for Std 5-10 and replace with a neutral instruction. 6) No correct answers revealed; use blank answer capture (checkbox-box / ans-sq-box for MCQ, fill-blank-line / ruled-line for written). 7) Technical tokens (input(), print(), MS Paint, RAM, CPU, AI, 123456, Input/Output) remain intact as English tokens but must have a Marathi gloss so a Marathi-only reader understands.
setup_instructions: None. Repo already at /projects/sandbox/ashram-school-exam-papers on branch marathi-bilingual-and-std5-or-questions (created off latest origin/main).
environment_constraints: No network needed. No build tooling. All edits are hand-authored HTML in index.html.
contribution_requirements: Preserve Std 1-4 exactly (visual 10-mark papers, existing images only). Rebuild Std 5-10 to the user-provided spec. Keep all existing CSS classes and the header/student-box/meta-chips/general-instructions scaffolding of each paper. Bilingual is additive (Marathi + English). Do NOT reveal correct answers. Devanagari must be natural.
